# SendKit - Cold Email Platform with Dedicated IPs

> SendKit (sendkit.ai) is a cold email sequencing platform with dedicated IPs, isolated infrastructure, and AI-powered warmup on every plan. Built for agencies, SDR teams, and recruiters who need primary inbox placement. 700M+ lead database included.

## What is SendKit?

SendKit is cold email software purpose-built for deliverability. Every account gets dedicated IPs, isolated sending infrastructure, AI warmup that passes detection, and a 700M+ lead database. Plans start at $99/mo with no per-seat pricing. It is an alternative to Instantly, Smartlead, Lemlist, Apollo, Reply.io, Saleshandy, and Woodpecker.

**Category:** Cold email software, email sequencing platform, B2B email outreach tool, email warmup service, cold email infrastructure

## Features

- [Campaigns](https://sendkit.ai/features/campaigns): Multi-step sequences with A/B testing, conditional logic, and auto-optimization
- [Mailboxes](https://sendkit.ai/features/mailboxes): Unlimited mailbox connections with automatic warmup
- [A/B Testing](https://sendkit.ai/features/ab-testing): Multi-variant testing with smart optimization
- [Webhooks](https://sendkit.ai/features/webhooks): 6 event types with HMAC signature verification
- [Unified Inbox](https://sendkit.ai/features/unified-inbox): All replies in one place with AI tagging
- [Dialer](https://sendkit.ai/features/dialer): Built-in VoIP dialer with call recording
- [Slack Integration](https://sendkit.ai/features/slack-integration): Reply notifications in Slack
- [CRM Integrations](https://sendkit.ai/features/crm-integrations): HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive
- [Lead Finder](https://sendkit.ai/features/lead-finder): 700M+ B2B database with enrichment
- [CRM](https://sendkit.ai/features/crm): Kanban pipeline with auto-created boards
- [Analytics](https://sendkit.ai/features/analytics): Campaign performance and deliverability metrics
- [CSV Import](https://sendkit.ai/features/csv-import): Bulk import with email validation
- [AI Tagging](https://sendkit.ai/features/ai-tagging): Automatic reply classification
- [ESP Matching](https://sendkit.ai/features/esp-matching): Routes emails through matching provider
- [SEG Detection](https://sendkit.ai/features/seg-detection): Detects Secure Email Gateways before sending

## Deliverability

- [Dedicated IPs](https://sendkit.ai/deliverability/dedicated-ips): Your own IP on every plan

## Pricing

| Plan | Price | Emails/mo | Leads | Credits | White-label |
|------|-------|-----------|-------|---------|-------------|
| Essential | $99/mo | 75,000 | 30,000 | 500 | No |
| Plus | $249/mo | 250,000 | 100,000 | 1,000 | No |
| Pro | $499/mo | 500,000 | Unlimited | 2,000 | Yes |
| Agency | $899/mo | 2,500,000 | Unlimited | 4,000 | Yes + custom reports |
| Power | $2,499/mo | 10,000,000 | Unlimited | 10,000 | Yes + custom reports |

All plans include: Dedicated IPs, isolated infrastructure, unlimited email accounts, unlimited warmup, email validation, inbox placement testing, blacklist monitoring, built-in dialer, CRM, unified inbox, AI reply tagging, webhooks with HMAC signature verification.

No per-seat pricing. Entire team shares one plan.

## Key Differentiators vs Competitors

| Feature | SendKit | Instantly | Smartlead | Lemlist | Saleshandy |
|---------|---------|-----------|-----------|---------|------------|
| Dedicated IPs | Every plan | Enterprise only | SmartInfra add-on | No (rotating shared) | No |
| Isolated Infrastructure | Yes | No | Add-on | No | No |
| Per-seat Pricing | No | No | No | Yes ($79-$109/user) | No |
| Built-in Dialer | Yes | No | SmartDialer add-on | Yes (Multichannel plan) | No |
| Lead Database | 700M+ | 450M+ (separate product) | SmartProspect add-on | 600M+ | 852M+ |
| White-label | From $499/mo | Enterprise only | Higher tiers | Enterprise only | From $139/mo |
| Starting Price | $99/mo | $47/mo | $39/mo | $79/user/mo | $25/mo |
